newsitem.title: USA: KeraVision ring clears regulatory hurdles.
newsitem.headline: KeraVision ring clears regulatory hurdles.

text.p: KeraVision Inc, a vision correction company, said it cleared the last major regulatory hurdle in Europe to commercialize its first product -- the KeraVision Ring to treat nearsightedness.

KeraVision said it received the right to affix the CE Mark to the ring, while also receiving ISO-9001 certification for the company's quality system. The small ring, inserted into the eye, subtly altered the curvature of the cornea, it said.
These actions opened the way for commercialization of the product in all European Union countries, KeraVision said.

"We believe we have developed a breakthrough technology that will fulfill many eyeglass and contact lens wearers' desire for an alternative to permanent and irreversible vision correction surgery techniques," said Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Thomas Loarie.

CE-Mark is the European Union equivalent of U.S. Food and Drug Administration premarket approval. The ISO-9001 is regulatory approval for quality system relating to the medical technology, KeraVision said.
